title: The Self-Limiting Nature of QBO-Dependent SAI: An Optimization Agent's Discovery of Intervention-Variability Feedback

contributions.purpose: 提出强制自证伪的可信优化智能体架构
contributions.mechanism: 三模块(统计验证/物理一致性/干预影响分析),对Goodhart定律的架构式解
contributions.evaluation: 定性;5-sigma异常阈触发自证伪协议
contributions.source_quote: The core innovation lies in the agent's mandatory self-falsification protocol, implemented through three integrated modules.

contributions.purpose: 提出干预-变率反馈原则
contributions.mechanism: 利用自然变率的优化会改变其所依赖的系统动力学,故本质自败
contributions.source_quote: The Intervention-Variability Feedback Principle: Climate interventions that attempt to optimize performance by exploiting natural variability patterns will modify the underlying system dynamics that create those patterns, making the optimization inherently self-defeating.

contributions.purpose: QBO定时SAI优化的自证伪案例
contributions.mechanism: MLR+bootstrap得初始'成功',经物理先验库判为异常,再经两反馈机制(erasing the map/poisoning the well)证伪
contributions.evaluation: Cohen's d=3.72(超遥相关均值0.21约43.9σ),1.69%效率增益被抵消
contributions.source_quote: Cross-validation revealed the effect size exceeded documented atmospheric teleconnections by 43.8 standard deviations (z=(3.72-0.21)/0.08).

self_declared_provenance.quote: The Intervention-Variability Feedback Principle is distinct from sociological observations like Goodhart's Law or economic concepts like the Lucas Critique...it is mechanistic and predictive at a physical level.

notes: 三部曲之一,自引[1][2](作者'AIXC'=自引环,疑破坏双盲)。整篇为负结果(优化自败),但核心数字d=3.72及作对照的物理先验知识库(1,257遥相关效应量,mean0.21/std0.08)疑为编造以撑起z=43.9σ异常叙事=循环自证。数据红旗:摘要在'weakening wind gradients by 15-25'处截断;AI Contribution Disclosure在'(2) Statistical validation revealing 1.69'处截断;方法数值互相矛盾(120月步 vs 612样本 vs 51年;OLS/岭回归α=0.1/Hedges' g/bootstrap n=1000/置换检验n=10000混用);Autonomy Metrics表(3247决策/0人工/847自证伪触发/2100物理检查/72.4h)可疑,且'847'与AS0329的'847 cross-domain patterns'雷同复用。反馈机制数值(2-4K加热、rate∝n²)为文献综述定性推断,无真实模拟。trade-off:两反馈时间尺度不同(erasing the map季-年 / poisoning the well 日-周)。
